facts.text: The image is a multi-panel cinematic character reference sheet on a black background, with a large hero image at the top and seven smaller labeled panels below.
The large top panel, labeled HERO, shows an adult standing on a rain-soaked rooftop or walkway at night, with wet reflective paving, metal railings on both sides, and out-of-focus city lights behind.
The person has dark hair that is shaved at the sides and gathered into a small topknot or bun at the back; a visible scar runs through one eyebrow in the face close-up.
In the HERO panel the person stands in profile facing left with arms relaxed at the sides, wearing a black collared jacket over a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up boots.
The three middle panels are labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK and show full-body turnaround views against a plain dark charcoal studio background in neutral standing poses.
The FRONT panel shows the person facing forward with arms at the sides; the SIDE PROFILE panel shows a left-facing profile; the BACK panel shows the rear view with the hair bun visible.
The bottom row contains four close-up detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

The FACE panel shows a tight close-up of the head and face; the JACKET COLLAR panel shows black jacket collar and strap or buckle hardware; the HANDS panel shows two hands with visible veins; the BOOTS panel shows black lace-up combat boots.
The hero panel uses cool blue-gray night lighting with warm amber bokeh highlights, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft directional studio lighting against dark backgrounds.
The palette is dominated by black and charcoal, with cool blue-gray tones, muted skin tones, and small warm amber accents.
Visible labels read exactly: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.
The sheet has a photorealistic cinematic concept-art style with a dark, rain-soaked neo-noir mood in the hero panel.

card.summary: A dark, cinematic character reference sheet for one adult figure, featuring a rain-soaked nighttime HERO image plus FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK turnarounds and close-up details of the FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

subjects.descriptor: Adult with East Asian facial features, shaved-side hair gathered into a small back bun, and a visible scar through one eyebrow.
attributes: dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot or bun
black collared jacket with strap and buckle hardware
pose: HERO: standing in profile facing left, arms relaxed at sides
FRONT: facing forward, arms at sides
SIDE PROFILE: standing in left-facing profile

card.environment: Rain-soaked rooftop or walkway at night with metal railings and distant city lights in the HERO panel; plain dark charcoal studio backdrop for the turnaround and detail panels.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting: cool blue-gray night ambience with warm amber bokeh highlights in the hero image, and soft directional studio light against dark backgrounds in the reference panels.
card.framing: Vertical multi-panel character sheet: large full-body hero atop three full-body turnaround views and four close-up detail crops.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic concept-art character reference sheet with a dark neo-noir mood.
card.characterisation: A dark, tactical-dressed adult character presented for design reference, with consistent hair, scar, and all-black clothing across multiple views.

limitations: The sheet does not establish the person's identity or biography.
As a still image, it provides no evidence of motion, dialogue, or sound.
Fine material details in the smaller detail panels are not fully resolvable.
